name: nutuk_benchmark_data
description: Benchmark dataset derived from Nutuk (a long historical/political text) intended to evaluate language-model understanding of Turkish historical text. It appears to include tasks such as question answering, summarization and related comprehension probes over Nutuk passages.
evaluation_method: task-specific metrics (exact_match / F1 for QA, ROUGE for summarization, BLEU for translation, accuracy for classification)
reputation: A niche Hugging Face dataset focused on a culturally specific corpus; limited visibility outside its target community.
